verses.text: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

xrefs.text: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
He tends His flock like a shepherd; He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart. He gently leads the nursing ewes.
My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me,

verses.text: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.

xrefs.text: For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’
Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb

I will bring them out from the peoples, gather them from the countries, and bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines, and in all the settlements of the land.
There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
And He told me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give freely from the spring of the water of life.

verses.text: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.

xrefs.text: I will lead the blind by a way they did not know; I will guide them on unfamiliar paths. I will turn darkness into light before them and rough places into level ground. These things I will do for them, and I will not forsake them.
For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.
The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.

verses.text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

xrefs.text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
But now, this is what the LORD says— He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.

verses.text: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.

xrefs.text: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.
You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.
You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

verses.text: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.

xrefs.text: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.
How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
